description: Minimum test count per tier. A suite that shrinks without explanation is a silently disabled suite — a broken include glob drops the unit tier from 1024 tests to 3 and every other gate still passes, because total > 0, failed === 0 and success === true.
howToRaise: Raise a floor in the same commit that adds the tests. Lowering one is also a reviewable diff — state why in the commit message.
establishedBy: PR CI run 19 (run id 30431556718), artifacts `evidence-unit-coverage` / `evidence-security-matrix` / `evidence-integration-tests`, files `test-totals-unit.json`, `test-totals-database.json`, `test-totals-backend.json`, at feature head 8d7bfff09cf914e00ff5ff4587341ece261185c3, started 2026-07-29T07:24:48Z, GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest. All three tiers now carry a hosted measurement; none is a local or carried-over figure.
enforcementNote: Only `minTests` is enforced — summarise-vitest.mjs fails a tier that runs fewer. `measured` is provenance: it records what the named run actually observed, so a later reader can see how much headroom a floor had when it was set.

unit.note: Raised from 1000 to 1050. Run 19 measured 1082 on a hosted runner, replacing the local 1024 that established the old floor. The floor keeps roughly 30 tests of headroom for ordinary churn while no longer sitting 82 below the real count, where it could have absorbed an entire deleted test file without complaint.

database.note: Unchanged. Run 19 re-measured 1624, identical to the P1-21 hosted figure the floor was set against, so there is nothing to correct.

backend.note: Unchanged. Run 19 re-measured 1380, identical to the P1-21 hosted figure, including the four H6 regression tests.

web.note: RAISED to 3700 by the P1-31 warranty record screens (FE-008, FE-009 partial), which added two web test files and 23 declared cases on top of the P1-30 tier and pushed the DECLARED count to 3073 across 135 files, above the previous floor of 3050 - `WTF-08` refused it, as it must. The raise is FORCED, not chosen, from three sides: `WTF-08` refuses a floor beneath cases that physically exist (3073); `WTF-09` refuses a headroom wider than the largest file in the tree (88 declared cases in `api-client.test.ts`), so with the tier EXECUTING 3749 the floor may not sit below 3661; and `baseline-integrity.test.ts` refuses a headroom under one per cent of the measurement, so it may not sit above 3711. 3700 is the round number inside that window. `measured` and `measuredFiles` move with the floor so that all three describe ONE run - 135 files, 3749 executed, 0 failed. TRACEABILITY, kept rather than dropped: the last HOSTED measurement this line of figures descends from is 3072 on 114 files, taken on PR #314 by GitHub-hosted PR CI run 33936553547 (`Web quality / web-quality`, artifact `evidence-web-quality`), recorded in the run ledger at b813fd77. See `measurementProvenance`.
web.whatTheHeadroomGuarantees: THE FLOOR DETECTS ANY NET LOSS OF MORE THAN 49 EXECUTED TESTS. That is measured (3749) minus the floor (3700), stated as the bound it actually is and recomputed from those two numbers rather than remembered. The largest web test file declares 88 cases and EXECUTES 136 (`api-client.test.ts` - `it.each` is one declaration and many cases), so the headroom sits below both and deleting that file trips the floor. Both tensions are satisfied: headroom above 0, so the floor is not a transcript of its own run, and below the largest file, so the deletion guarantee holds.
web.measuredFilesNote: `measuredFiles` is 135 - physical `*.test.ts`/`*.test.tsx` files under `apps/web/tests`, matching the tier as this branch holds it, and moved with `measured` so the two describe one run. It read 379 once, because `summarise()` populated it from `numTotalTestSuites`, which vitest sets to every `describe` block recursively. `measuredSuites` is retained so a reader comparing against an older artifact can see which number changed meaning rather than assuming the tier shrank.
web.measurementProvenance: LOCAL, and weaker than a hosted figure. 3749 is what the web tier executed on the P1-31 warranty-screens head (135 files, 3749 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 0 todo), taken by `check-p1-27-closing-values.mjs --record web` and written to `docs/phase-1/phase-1-27/evidence/local-run-ledger.json` with the commit it was taken at; the hosted run of this branch had not yet reported when the floor had to move, and `WTF-08` does not wait. WHAT REPLACES IT: the next HOSTED `Web quality / web-quality` run of this branch, whose `test-totals-web.json` is the figure QA-005 binds through that ledger (`--record web --hosted-run`) - the ledger, not this field, is the authority a test reads, and it expires the moment any executable path changes. TRACEABILITY of the last HOSTED measurement this line of figures descends from, kept rather than dropped: 3072 on 114 files at b813fd77, GitHub-hosted PR CI run 33936553547 (PR #314, `Web quality / web-quality`, artifact `evidence-web-quality`, digest-checked). Before it: 1867 on a 70-file tree at 424e5d884ed7c8f608c446408743cbf88ac80515 by run 31508526699, re-confirmed at 03e84f1f244252903569619de72481f30238e76a by run 31514783205.

unitFloorCaveat: The unit floor is deliberately NOT set to the measurement of the run that carries this commit. This change adds twenty tests — eight in tests/ci/dependency-path-proof.test.ts (AR-49), four in the workflow-security rule-registry suite (AR-50), four in tests/ci/baseline-integrity.test.ts covering the baselines established here, and four in tests/ci/documented-counts.test.ts (AR-51) — so the final head measures 1102, not the 1082 recorded above. Setting 1102 as the floor would make it a transcript of the last run rather than a guard, and every future commit would have to move it. 1050 is the guard; 1082 stays as the provenance of run 19. Note that this sentence is itself the kind of hand-written count AR-51 was about, which is why the floor and the provenance figure — the two values anything actually reads — are measured rather than narrated.
